## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-arena-elo-by-axis`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-arena-elo-by-axis -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `elo_reference.json`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `elo_reference.json`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

**Independent measurement of public Arena Elo split by GSPC axis. Not a certification.**

- Verify any card free: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/ · Catalog: https://councilof.ai/catalog.json · Methodology: https://councilof.ai/methodology/
- Live board: https://councilof.ai/api/gspc (read counts live; none are typed here)

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/arena-elo-by-axis at revision `5a363fbc8eb2852c444a25331110a076d7570505`, made 2026-10-06. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# Arena Elo by axis (not a board score)

A pairwise-arena Elo reference computed per axis. `elo_reference.json` carries the
axis list, a `content_id` over the payload, and a leaderboard row per model: `elo`, `games`, `winrate` and a
confidence interval. This is an **arena** number over head-to-head rounds — it is not a GSPC board score and
does not write to any slot.

# Arena Elo by axis (not a board score)

A pairwise-arena Elo reference computed per axis. `elo_reference.json` carries the
axis list, a `content_id` over the payload, and a leaderboard row per model: `elo`, `games`, `winrate` and a
confidence interval. This is an **arena** number over head-to-head rounds — it is not a GSPC board score and
